diagnosis.overview: The agent lacks a reliable mechanism to extract precise numeric values and formatting details from source files, causing hallucinated data, computational omissions, and infinite file-verification loops.
diagnosis.root_cause: The agent lacks a reliable mechanism to extract precise numeric values and formatting details from source files, causing hallucinated data, computational omissions, and infinite file-verification loops.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: 1) Add a robust file parsing tool (e.g., a Python-based CSV/Excel reader or a dedicated text extraction utility) that returns exact cell values and structural metadata without the tool errors observed; 2) Introduce a prompt rule requiring the agent to explicitly extract, display, and cross-check all critical numbers and formatting against the parsed source output before generating the deliverable, and to halt if extraction fails.
